Oh, but make sure you bring me some cigarettes as a gift.

Master and Servant, huh? You and I are both here...it's as simple as that.
Don't you fret. The Takeda will always be here to support you.

What I like? Let's see...cars are nice, but relaxing in a hot springs is nice too. You'd be surprised to learn I actually had a few hidden springs. Hot springs are the best way to heal the wounds of battle.
Want me to take you to one?

You heard I didn't like caterpillars? Who the heck told you something so stupid? How did that... No, I'm going to be straight with you: I actually don't like them. Happy?
Hey, wait a minute...don't tell me you have one on you right now... If you do, don't take it out.
...Don't you dare.

A Holy Grail that grants wishes, huh? Sound dubious, but dangling such obvious bait to pit people against each other makes me think the world of magecraft and the Warring States period aren't so different, after all.

It's pretty obvious I'm a Rider. I dare you to show me someone better suited to command Takeda's cavalry than myself. 
What's that? There's a bunch of people here who are versed in riding?
Sounds like a challenge. All right, gather them all and let's have a race!

Cars are great. They didn't exist in my lifetime, but I can certainly say it was worth getting summoned since it means I can burn rubber with this thing.
A contraption with latent wild power that can cut through the wind, an engine that roars, and wheels that leave a mark on the ground...this iron steed is a worthy ride.

I like the color red. Red represents the Takeda, the red of flames, and the color of blood that represents lineage. That's something I can't change about myself. 
That's why I wear red, let my blood boil with passion, and stand on the battlefield. Besides...red is cool, don't you think?

Oh, it's you. Hey, come with me. Let's go out riding...or rather, go on a extended drive. If you heard me, then hurry up and get ready.
Heh...I never dreamed I would ever meet someone worthy to be by my side, let alone that it would happen after I became a Heroic Spirit. 
Well, today we're going to keep driving to who knows where, so be prepared.

I've carried the Takeda name since birth and lived my life for the sake of the Takeda. I wasn't allowed to live any other way, nor did I think to try otherwise. I may have some regrets about the fate that awaited me at the end, but I have accepted it.
But now, through a strange twist of fate, I stand before you. I realize you carry a far greater weight than I did back in the day.
If you choose to continue to bear that weight and move forward, then I will support you not as a man of the Takeda, but as an ordinary human being.

There was nobody stronger than me during the Warring States. I'm not bluffing or exaggerating. It was true; no man could beat me.
Kenshin? She was a woman, so I'm still technically telling the truth. Well, I actually don't know what the heck her deal is, but all I can say is that I never want get involved with her again.
...I say that, but she keeps showing up. Seriously, what the heck?

I've heard about the three line formation. What of it? I don't care since it wasn't my Takeda that lost to Nobunaga. It was a different Takeda I wasn't involved with. Katsuyori's Takeda was his responsibility, so it's not my place to say anything about it.
That aside, I'm not sure about calling oneself the Demon King of the Sixth Heaven... I feel like just hearing that name is costing me brain cells.

That Saber woman in red...where is she from? Nothing, I just thought she was wearing a lovely shade of red.
What? She's a Roman Emperor?
I see... I knew no ordinary person would wear such an exquisite red, so now I get it.

Hey. Who's that guy that looks like a horsetail? Nobunaga's younger brother? Him?
I see...so he sacrifices himself for Nobunaga... No wonder he caught my attention.
Uh, it's nothing. I take back what I just said.

Ah, I was wondering who you were. You're Yoshinari's son. I hear that after my death, you caused quite the commotion in Kai. The Takeda crossed spears with your father numerous times, and he sure lived up to the nickname of "Sanza the Attacker."
As his son, I'd like to see how you fare in combat.

Iskandar, the King of Conquerors...that sure is a nice red cape you've got there. And I like that magnificent chariot you have as well. If I get the chance, I'd like to grab a drink with you. I know a good place in my hometown. Why don't you come with me?

Nobushige... I did not deserve so great a younger brother. If he decided to claim Kai, I would have been happy to be defeated by him. But Nobushige did not do that, and nothing of the sort happened. I took over Kai, and he ended up living his life for my sake.
Thank you, my dearest younger brother.

The elderly possess an invisible power called experience. That's why I warn you not to judge others by their  appearances and lose sight of their talents and significance. Take a look at Shinpachi. He may be old, but he...
No, he's not a good example. And actually, I think he's more energetic than when he was young.

Ujizane... After I inherited Kai from my father, and he Suruga from his father, we crossed swords.
It's one thing to say that we simply did what was expected of us during the turbulent times, but our numerous victories also burdened us... Children have it tough too.
Come! Kurokumo!
Stamp them down!
Endure it.

Fou's body is damp from all this humidity...

I've only seen it in the videos in the library, but I would love to see real fireflies glow.
And hopefully...um...with Senpai...

Lostbelts...
The possibilities that were deemed unnecessary and placed on dead-end tracks...

What is my favorite firework, you ask?
It may be a dull response, but I do like Japanese sparklers. They only last for a little bit, which makes it sad, but it does remind me that I should cherish those brief moments.

What kind of wish did you write down for Tanabata?
I wrote...um, well, it's a secret.

I'm not sure what this thing Da Vinci gave me is...
Hm? An inflatable pool?
I can't believe this can make a pool inside a room! I must try this out.
Please standby, Master...I'm just going to change into my swimsuit really quick!

Bamboo arranged around the room in such an intricate network... Does this mean tonight's menu is going to be somen noodles delivered on a bamboo water slide, or nagashi somen?
I would never have imagined we could have such a fun meal in our current situation!

It's very hot outside, and opening up the Border's windows to let the breeze in feels so nice.
Traveling is wonderful!

The moon-viewing season is here once again.
That chaotic scene over dumplings brings back memories like it was just yesterday.

You've done splendidly in the Singularity.
We were lucky to collect such precious resources.
We must make good use of them.
It's still quite hot, so please be mindful of your health. If you feel anything strange, please head to the infirmary immediately. You should never drag your feet about things like this.

What comes to mind when we talk about the month of September, Senpai?
I see... Typhoons and the chirping of bugs...
I suppose there wouldn't be any of those in a place like this.
It looks like Fou's growing his winter coat. To be honest, it's hard to tell because he's already so fluffy.

It's the season of fall reading.
On a day like today, I would love to just relax and read a book until I fall asleep. Are there any books that you recommend, Senpai?

Senpai, according to Da Vinci's weather forecast, it's supposed to be unusually chilly today. It might be a good idea to take a jacket with you. But I can also warm you up using Ortinax's radiators if needed!

Oh I-I'm sorry, Senpai. Did I wake you?
I saw that you fell asleep at your desk, so I thought I would cover you with a blanket so you wouldn't catch a cold...
I-I didn't do anything beyond that. I promise.

I hear there is a Japanese festival called the Tori no Ichi, where people wish for good fortune and prosperity.
My only experience with it is from the library, but it sounded like something perfect for Jaguar Warrior.
It looks so fun and lively.

Senpai. Da Vinci gave me this strange candy. It looks like red and white glow sticks... Eh? They're Japanese sugar sticks called "chitose-ame"?
I see. That is very interesting!

So much happened this year, and now the year is drawing to an end...
Do you have any unfinished business, Master?
December may be the busiest month of the year, but there's still time to catch up!

Despite our situation, we shouldn't forget to prepare for the new year.
We are going to get very busy, Senpai!

They say an outstanding Master always has outstanding luck.
...Well actually, that's just something I thought of...
Anyway, it's all about collecting resources, Master! Let's save them wisely!

It seems like we now have a good number of Santas now...
Is it normal for there to be more Santas every year?

Happy New Year, Senpai!
Teehee...I really like saying that, even though you can only do it once a year.
Um...I would very much like to do it again...next year.

A very happy New Year!
I wonder what's in store for us this year?
But no matter what it may be, I will only give my best.
I look forward to working with you again this year, Master!

I hear people in Japan exchange New Years postcards called nengajou. I would like to send some out one day.
Eh? I can send them right now? And give them by hand? P-please wait a moment! I'm just going to grab some postcards right now!
It seems our situation has slowly been changing. We'll need to be careful not to fall ill due to the change in environment.

As it's a new year, it may be a good idea to start something new.
Is there anything that might interest you, Senpai?

Ah...ah...ah-choo!
S-Senpai...you didn't happen to hear that, did you!?
The season to exchange chocolates is here once again. It seems livelier this year than in the past. If I had to guess why...I'd say it's all the voices...

Eating udon at the cafeteria versus eating nabeyaki udon in my own room...
I didn't think there would be any difference until I tried it...but what a surprise.
I feel like I could write an entire thesis on this subject, Senpai.

I looked up a plant called "horsetail" in the library. The way it looks like it's trying really hard to stretch up to the skies is so cute. And the name horsetail is appropriate because of how it looks!
I wonder if it's delicious to eat...

Senpai, did the Rayshift make you sick?
How many resources do you see?
...No, actually there's fewer than that.
Shall I fetch the Doctor?

Feeling the nice warm spring breeze is uplifting.
Come on, Master. Let's complete the mission quickly!
Girls' Day is one of my favorite celebrations. You line up all those miniature dolls and display them. The pink-themed color scheme and the male and female dolls all look very cute!

Plum blossoms, peach blossoms, and cherry blossoms.
Hmmm...distinguishing them is quite difficult, but they are all beautiful.

The spring sunlight is getting more intense.
At this rate, summer's just around the corner. We should enjoy going on spring excursions while we have the chance!

Senpai, do you know the difference between hiking and picnicking? Supposedly it's a difference between whether your focus is on walking or eating your lunch.
I think both are wonderful. After all, both activities involve an outing with you!

Viewing flowers is fun, but I hear that it's more fun if you are able to drink.
How much happier do you think these people who can drink and view flowers are, compared to us?
I'd sure like to be an adult soon...

Spring is winding down. Is there anything you wanted to do, Senpai?
And don't forget to do this mission, of course!

Master. Da Vinci said she hung some flags shaped like carp outside the Border! She says she made them inconspicuous using some sort of active camouflage effect or something!
It's great that we won't be detected by enemies, but I can't see them that well either...

How curious. It's been said in the past by many others, but I also feel that the combination of rain and hydrangeas are wonderful.
Is this what you call aesthetics?

Today's weather tells us that it's the start of summer.
Let's get our bodies ready in anticipation of the season to come!

The situation has been resolved.
What had happened in the Singularity will never be recorded in history, but it will remain within our memories.
I just hope I can accompany Senpai in the battles to come.

We should enjoy the time spent indoors in a meaningful way, especially when we can't go outdoors. Whether that's helping clean up your room, or playing board games with you, Mash Kyrielight will be ready at a moments notice!

Celebrating our four year anniversary...
I'm not entirely sure why, but saying that is exciting. I have a feeling we will meet a lot of new people!
I hear Caesar is working out in preparation for summer. He is a Servant though, so I don't think there will be much change...
We're at the halfway point of the year. Let's plan ahead for the rest of the year!

Summer is here!
I'm even excited about the Master Missions.
Let's not succumb to the heat and make sure we keep our health and safety in mind!

The Holy Grails that we've been collecting are genuine, potent sources of magical energy.
The Holy Grail that is said to be an omnipotent wish granting device, while its structure is similar to ours, is different in scale and lifespan. Please don't forget that.
We now have more Servants wearing swimsuits, but I'm starting to hope that Senpai starts wearing one as well.

It looks like the summer festivities have ended without incident.
It doesn't seem like we have another big event for a while, so let's just take it easy.

Are you leveling up everyone's Skills?
Some Servants can fight well even with low level Skills, while some Skills change in functionality entirely when they reach maximum level. Think carefully when enhancing them, and your tactical options will expand.

While you have only a limited number of Holy Grails, hoarding them would also be a waste.
Please use them on Servants who you feel you should.

We managed to return safely once more.
Our battles will get tougher, so please command me with all your resolve.
...Anyway, here are the resources we collected this time!
What's this? Well, I asked Ms. Murasaki to recommend some books. They say that autumn is the best season for reading, you know!

Even if it's just in the simulator, maybe we should go see the autumn foliage.
I'll be more than happy to apprentice under Cat to learn the art of bento-making!

Hm!? A blackout.
Don't worry. I'm an expert at this now.
I can give you your Saint Quartz Fragments with my eyes closed. Here you go!

The base's population is booming, but it's just you and me here as usual.
I kind of like that this place stays constant and unchanging.

The distinctive scent that fills the air when I pull our winter clothes out of storage conjures so many memories...
I like that it reminds me of the seasons changing.

Now that I think about it, do you suppose it snows in the Wandering Sea?
And if it does, I wonder what that looks like. I'm very curious about this...
I'll ask Sion next time!

The Santa Servants are starting to get restless.
I guess it's that time of the year already!

In preparation for the big end of the year cleaning, I've stocked up on new cleaning supplies!!
Now I'll be ready anytime!

Senpai! I hear Beni-Enma is going to prepare us all special New Year's soba!
Oh my...
I'm getting so excited, I'm feeling dizzy!

Happy New Year, Master!
I love how this year is just full of twos!
And on that note, let's begin this year with a fresh mindset...too!

I hear people usually either spend the New Year by taking it easy or going out and painting the town red...
How do you spend your time, Senpai?

It's a new year.
This might be an opportune time to try something new!

What is your favorite way to eat mochi, Senpai?
My favorite way is...
Hmmm...I really can't decide, to be honest...

I just had an epiphany about a new food to eat at the kotatsu that beats mandarin oranges or nabeyaki udon!
Ice cream!
It's a true guilty pleasure only advanced kotatsu experts will appreciate!

The season of sweets is upon us once again.
Just don't forget to brush your teeth to prevent cavities, Master.

The days are still chilly.
When I wake up in the morning and find Fou sleeping next to me in bed, I feel very lucky.

Did you know that the next leap year is going to be in two years?
Just the thought of having an extra day in a year makes me feel like I gained something special, Senpai!

It's March.
Did you know that the month is named after Mars, the god of war?
...I wonder how Altera would react if she heard.

So this dish is called chirashizushi!?
It's so colorful and it's definitely fit for auspicious events!
I'm sure it's also delicious...!
Gulp!
It's hard to notice the changing of the seasons here...but it's probably best to continue to bear that in mind.

Have you ever been to a school orientation before, Senpai?
I hear it makes you quite nervous...
Please tell me about it one of these days!

Flower-viewing season is upon us once again, and the simulator is very popular right now.
Shall we also check it out, Senpai?
I'll prepare a picnic, blanket and all!

All resources are valuable.
Remember that dazzling sparkle, and be thrilled by that spiky shape...
Come on, Master! Let's get to work on our missions!

Old Japanese calendars used to call the month of May "Satsuki," which is associated with the rice planting season.
If we have the chance, I would very much like to try my hand at planting rice!
...If there is ever such a mission, that is...

Whoa! Senpai and Fou just yawned at the same time!
I wish I'd taken a picture of such perfect synchronization!
Hehe...feeling drowsy all the time is a sure sign that it's spring!

I've gotten the hang of polishing Saint Quartz Fragments!
They're shiny enough that you can see yourself in them, Senpai!
...Do you think if we ask Da Vinci, she could make this a part of some sort of interior design?

Senpai, here are your new workout outfits and indoor shoes. Please wear them during your workout routine.
I also received a similar set with the same design!
Maybe you and I should go on a jog together?

It's starting to feel like summer.
I have a strange sense that this summer will be our scariest ever...
No, I shouldn't say such crazy things... Please ignore what I said!

It's the most humid part of the year, so make sure to get a lot of circulation in your room!
You wouldn't want to be scolded by bread makers for accidently letting their bread get moldy, Senpai!

It's almost summer.
You may want to just settle for eating something simple, but try to eat a well-balanced meal to build up your strength.

Missions may change on a weekly basis, but you have plenty of time to complete them.
Work on the missions at your own pace.

"Playing board games is fine, but it's also good to have an outdoor hobby, like fishing."
...At least that's what Emiya said.
Fishing in Chaldea...may be a bit challenging.

The hot summer has come once again!
I hear that people get extended days-off during this time.
Prepare yourself well against the heat and enjoy your vacation!

Use the Holy Grails you obtained to further strengthen your Servants' Spirit Origins.
You may feel compelled to hold on to them, but sometimes it's best to take the plunge and use them!

Summer excursions aren't just limited to the beach.
You can enjoy camping up in the mountains...
It appears you can even play in and learn from nature.
That does seem fun.

We're about halfway through the year already.
The days may still be hot, but let's keep a positive mindset and live the time we have to the fullest!

I hear that Ascension and strengthening a Servant's Spirit Origin using a Holy Grail are different things.
A Heroic Spirit's Spirit Origin is set based on a Servant's information from their past life, no matter how far you Ascend them. But you can use a Holy Grail to foster a special kind of growth.

Is your party fully strengthened and at the ready?
Instead of focusing only on Servants specializing in offense, try training Servants who specialize in defense and support too.

The records of those who left their mark on human history, whether good or bad, which are known as Heroic Spirits in Chaldea, are collected and stored in a higher realm called the Throne.
...And that's why anybody who has not achieved anything truly great never becomes a Servant candidate.
Though it seems that occasionally, a string of coincidences and a touch of fate can lead to a miracle.

Summer is over, and we're heading into the next season.
Is your wardrobe ready for the changing season?
Please take every precaution to ensure you stay healthy!

Try raising various Servants in anticipation of the many battles ahead.
Servants are all unique in their own way, and they are all reliable when the time comes!

A war between Masters over the Holy Grail...

Changing into different Mystic Codes depending on the situation is what makes a veteran Master. There are many skills associated with the different Mystic Codes, so please try changing to suit your party.

Christmas is here!
I wonder what sort of Santa we'll have this year? I'm so excited!

Servants are divided into attack and support types. A majority of the Caster-class Servants are support types, so try not to form your party with just Sabers or Lancers; try using Casters to help you out.

It's now 2023. Happy New Year!
I hope we have yet another wonderful year, Senpai!

This year is the Year of the Ox. It’s Raikou’s year!
Oh. I wasn't thinking about her physique, but rather about when she got really serious at Onigashima...
It's getting really cold now. Don't forget to wear gloves and a mask when you head out. Your neck is the most vulnerable to cold, so wearing a scarf would also be helpful.

Osechi, the traditional Japanese New Years meal set, is a nice culinary tradition.
It's aesthetically pleasing, each dish goes down easy, and they're all so delicious...
The fact that most of the dishes are sweet is wonderful too!
I hear that you can eat the same amount of black soybeans as your age! Yay!
There are more Daily and Weekly mission types now. But don't worry if you're busy. You just need to do the quests at your own pace.
The season for chocolates is upon us once again. Please be careful not to get any cavities, Senpai.
Have you been using Holy Grails, Master? You can spread them among numerous Servants or focus on one Servant. There's nothing for you to lose, so have at it.

By the way, I picked this up earlier. It seems like some sort of...calling card.
I thought it was Carmilla's, but it's not. The plot thickens, Senpai.

March... It's graduation season in Japan.

What about you, Senpai...no, wait! Never mind!

Orion was agonizing over what to give Artemis as a return gift. He was claiming that it would also be terrible if he put TOO much sentiment into his return gift too. That is definitely a concern you'd only have with Artemis.
QP, short for Quantum Pieces, should be diligently collected and saved. You may not use much at first, but you will gradually have more and more use for them.

One, two, three...
Oh, Senpai! N-nothing. I was just practicing my dancing, since it's spring and all.
Would you like to join me, Senpai?
Edison is currently researching whether we can increase the amount of Saint Quartz Fragments. I  honestly think that's a tall order, even for the king of inventions...

This is... a very valuable resource! 
You always work so hard, and now I've finally seen your destiny realized!

If you use just one Servant as an attacker during a turn, you will only be able to attack one enemy. But if you put a Noble Phantasm between attacks, you can potentially attack two or even three enemies. Think about the enemy's HP gauge and build strategies.
You'll wind up out of shape if you stay cooped up in Chaldea. Would you like to try some training exercises you could do indoors?
According to Da Vinci's analysis, we're bound to see a lot of minute Singularities again this year. Let's try our best to tackle them, Senpai!
Firing Noble Phantasms in one turn feels really good...but certain enemies have Break Bars, so it's meaningless to inflict damage with your Noble Phantasm on those enemies. Please be careful.

June... It's the rainy season in Japan.
Senpai, when you told me the Japanese term uses the kanji "plum" and "rain," I thought it meant the rain was sour like plums. Teehee.

Holmes is the world's most famous detective, and he has been the subject of many paintings and sculptures. However, the inverness coat and deerstalker hat he's famously depicted with were never described in the original stories. That was apparently created by the person who was in charge of the book's illustrations.
Evade and Invincibility have two different durations: times and turns. The times effect is quickly used up if you're up against large enemies who have AOE attacks, so please be careful.
Summer's about to start again. I have a feeling a thrilling adventure awaits us! Let's prepare while we have the chance!

Have you been practicing proper precautions against the heat? Please be careful not to get afflicted with heat stress, Senpai.
Then again, it's not good to cool yourself too much too. Balancing both is quite challenging...

The C. Stars dropped from attacking enemies or from skills increase the chance to inflict a Critical Hit by 10% each.
Please also keep in mind that certain classes have easier or harder times gathering C. Stars.
It's getting even hotter these days. Please do take care of yourself, Senpai. I hear Emiya is thinking up dishes that are good for fighting the heat.

I believe holding hands is proof of trust and friendship.
...Ahem. Senpai, would you like to shake hands?
I know the days have been hot, but it'll be autumn soon, and that's more comfortable. Until then, let's enjoy the summer, Senpai.
It's September already. Time sure does fly. I hear in Japan many fruits are in season. What kind of fruits were available and loved in your hometown, Master?
The seasons in the northern and southern hemispheres are flipped. For example, in Australia, it's a pleasantly warm spring right now and it's supposed to get hotter and hotter.
Edison and Tesla claim to have invented a "revolutionary weather forecast machine." But honestly, where in Chaldea are they going to use this device?

It's autumn! Master, I hope you're prepared.
Come on, let's prepare pumpkins!

Master, Master!
Elisabeth is in such a good mood, she started singing in the cafeteria! Everyone's begging you to go to the cafeteria immediately!

It's starting to get chilly.
Try not to catch a cold due to the changing seasons. Make sure you're well-protected from the cold before you Rayshift! Though the season wherever you Rayshift may not necessarily be the same...

It's winter now. Prepare all the necessary equipment so you aren't harmed by the harsh weather.
Just like combat, it's important to be on your guard and defend yourself!

(Huff, huff...)
!
I can't believe the sweet potato we roasted using just the leaves we collected turned out so delicious... What kind of skill did you use, Senpai!?
Scheherazade is going to hold a reading tonight. I'm excited to see what kind of story she'll read. But I need to be careful not to stay up too late because I get too engrossed in it.

We need to do some major cleaning to prepare for the new year. Let's get to it, Master!
Come to think of it, even though we've gotten more sophisticated equipment and technology to help us clean, why it still takes the same amount of time and effort is a mystery.
I wonder...
Even more delicious scents than ever are filling the air this Christmas! I wonder what kind of feast we'll have this year?

There's only so many more days left in the year. Do you have any unfinished business before the new year, Senpai?
Letting the last, busiest month of the year pass in idleness is a loss of time. But try not to give up yet!

Happy New Year.
I'm very happy to be able to say that once again this year to you and everyone else.

Happy New Year, Senpai.
This year is the Year of the Tiger. Might I suggest visiting a shrine with Jaguar Warrior and Tamamo Cat?
Huh? Tamamo Cat technically doesn’t fit into that category? Y-you’re right!

I wonder what sort of places we'll go, and what kind of things we'll see this year...
It would be wonderful if we could look back on these memories with a smile one day.
Master! Did you know that a different type of ozoni, the new year's mochi soup, has appeared this year!? I had no idea this dish was so versatile! That teaches me not to underestimate ozoni.
Uh. Fou is hanging around my neck and relaxing... This is the first time he's done that this year. I don't need to wear a scarf because he's keeping me warm...very nice.

It's February!
With the excitement of New Year's over, everyone seems so determined to face the rest of the year!
I, too, will be working hard on my duties, training, and making chocolate!

The technology here at the Atlas Institute is astonishing. I can't believe we can now cast Holy Grails...
Then again, Sion says:
"Oh, that is only a replica that looks like a Holy Grail. It just holds the same amount of magical energy, but it doesn't have the capacity to grant the owner's wish."
That's still an amazing feat in itself!

Tamamo-no-Mae seems to carry herself with sacred dignity, given that her wardrobes are shrine maiden's outfits or twelve-layered ceremonial kimonos and whatnot. But when you get to know her, she's a sophisticated, graceful, and meticulous Japanese woman.
And yet...
It appears she has numerous avatars that are her alter egos...and one of them includes Tamamo Cat...
March... We are heading into spring! It might be early for flower viewing, but maybe it would be nice to take a stroll through a row of cherry blossom trees and reminisce about our daily lives.

Master, have you ever visited Miss Crane's workshop? She handles many of the Spiritron Dresses you may have missed out on, so please visit if you are interested. You can get there from the Shop by selecting the Dress Making section.

Nero was the fifth Emperor of Rome, but she was dubbed a tyrant in her later years, along with a handful of other rumors and theories surrounding her. One of the more prevalent theories is the number of the beast which holds that 666 is a numerical representation of Nero's name and title.

That is intriguing...just a bit...

April. It's the season of spring and new beginnings! We should set up a schedule to help us enjoy spring with an eye toward all the consecutive holidays in May!
I have a feeling we will encounter many wonderful people along the way!

Have you been unlocking everyone's Append Skills?
They are passive skills which are always active, rather than skills used during battle. They are very useful, so I advise you to be proactive about unlocking them.
I recommend none other than Leonidas's Append Skill!

According to my research, Captain Nemo loves sweets. But I hear Captain does not eat them in front of others to maintain decorum and to keep everyone in Chaldea on edge. What impressive willpower... I one thousand percent respect that.
On the other hand, the Marines always have a mound of sweets for dessert at lunch.

To prepare for a picnic, I am practicing making bento boxes. I noticed that the art of bento-making is profound, as there are some things you would never think to do when cooking normally.
Diligence and devotion are the key to improvement!

Happy New Year. 
I look forward to working with you again this year!

Wow...what a lovely sunrise.
I can see why Sei Shounagon says "dawn is most beautiful in spring."
Senpai! Galatea has made me some May Festival dolls for Tango no Sekku, or the Childrens' Day celebration! They are made with astonishing quality!

Some people may feel down after a continuous bout of rain, but I don't mind it much.
The sound of rain pattering against the window calms me... Oh, could that sound be Tristan's harp? The two sounds together make a wonderful background music!
There seem to be more Extra Missions than before. Obviously that means more rewards for completing them, so let's go!

I just saw Semiramis carrying an armful of hydrangeas, and I thought it was a beautiful sight. But I later learned she was only researching their poisonous qualities... I guess some people prioritize dumplings over flowers, while some prefer poison over flowers...

Recently I've been in the habit of training on a stationary bicycle while also using the simulator's technology. Today, I think I'll cycle through the grape fields of Burgundy. Would you like to join me, Senpai?
It's the season when flowers begin to bloom. Van Gogh seems more lively because of it, or...not...

Summer seems to be in full swing now, Senpai.
I think I'm starting to understand what you really need to prepare for summer. Rather than preparing summer outfits and swimsuits, it's important to be mentally prepared for anything that may be thrown at us without getting flustered!

Chaldea's summer break season is once again upon us! We should stay on our guard so we can deal with whatever pops up in a calm manner. But then again Senpai, it would be wonderful if you could anticipate at least SOME summer fun, since we are already in the middle of summer!

Anastasia held a shaved ice party recently. Though I hear the many colorful syrups all tasted the same. Still, it was interesting to see everyone's choice of colors.
What do you think I chose, Senpai? Eh? You can tell right away because my tongue's dyed that color?
P-please don't look at it!!!

Have you been to the temple yet? 
If not, then let's go together...!

Zhuge Liang always acts perfectly composed in his suit despite the heat. I asked him how he can maintain his cool, and he replied that he uses a spell to regulate his body temperature at all times.
I said that's definitely something a top-tier Caster would do...but then Sima Yi, who was standing nearby, burst out laughing. I wonder why?

The long sobs/Of violins/Of autumn...
That is the start of a certain French poem, but I suppose you may be more familiar with its Japanese translation. Your language does have a special ring to it, and I'm sure the world is full of beauty created not only by the original, but also by the differences between languages. I am going to try to learn even more languages to realize such elegance on my own.

The calendar may be telling us that we have entered autumn, but it's still quite warm out.
Please avoid keeping the AC on for too long, don't drink too many cold beverages, and take good care of yourself. I recommend you soak in a warm tub, rather than take a quick shower, so you can warm your entire body to the core!

As we approach the season for harvesting rice, I'm reminded of the days we spent in Yamataikoku. And I see that Himiko has made herself comfortable next to the boiler room... I honestly don't know why everyone from the GUDAGUDA events is drawn to the boiler. Is it because it's nice and warm?

It's October. Lately, it's been chilly even in springtime, while it's been hot even during autumn and winter, and so my impression of the changing seasons has been slightly altered. Do you know of anyone who would have an idea of how to prepare for seasonal shifts like this?

Senpai, have you noticed something? October means autumn, and that means an event is coming up... Yes, this is the season when pumpkins are delicious. I love food made from pumpkins, like soups and casseroles...and I suppose you prefer Japanese braised pumpkins.
I'm thinking of making a pumpkin pie with Emiya and everyone in the kitchen. We must strengthen ourselves before the festivities begin!

Given that this season is between summer and winter, there are so many delicious foods, it's always hard for me to resist.
I may be able to increase my sweets repertoire with seasonal fruits...
Oh, you're saying you're looking forward to my recipes?
N-no! I can't possibly serve you anything unless it turns out absolutely perfect!

I sense some sort of festival happening. In fact, a massive event we've never seen before.
We have already experienced a colosseum event, an event in New York, and even invaders from outer space...
If I can make a request, I would like a cute fairy-tale event next time!

It seems we're nearing the end of the year already.
Do you have any unfinished business this year? If so, I advise you to handle it now.

It appears Murasaki Shikibu is encouraging everyone to use the library by claiming autumn is the season for reading, and that everyone should catch up on their reading before the year ends. I'm thinking of reading the books I've had my eye on. What about you, Senpai?

Happy New Year, Senpai.
I'm glad to have a chance to tell you that this year.

Shakespeare writes the manuscript...Van Gogh illustrates the cover...and Caesar sells the book...
There was apparently a grandiose plan of that sort in the works earlier.
And yes, you've correctly guessed that the plan fizzled out in its early stages.

Most scenery can be replicated using the simulator, which is why it's understandable for Servants to stay in there for hours.
Where would you like to visit today?
This year is almost at to an end. But please continue to take good care of yourself. Do not forget to bundle up to keep warm so you don't catch a cold.
The season to eat hot pot has arrived. Believe it or not, Okita and Nobunaga have prepared one. Would you like to join us, Senpai?

Happy New Year!
I look forward to working with you this year both as my Senpai and Master!
Raikou, Boudica, and Chacha gave me lucky envelopes. I'm so grateful. It's fun to think about how to spend the money, isn't it, Senpai?

There appear to be many kinds of fairies from different countries and different ages.
...I think I was dreaming... I recently dreamed about adventuring with a positive, hardworking, and very mysterious person...
At least I...think...

Most Servants seem to have been be unaffected by illness while they lived...
If you catch a cold...I will of course nurse you back to health with wholehearted devotion!
This morning I saw Fou sleeping above your head, Senpai. Were you very warm? Oh, he was heavy... I see...I suppose that's true...

Coffee...green tea...milk...alcohol...and chai...
I asked everyone what they thought would pair well with chocolate, but I never imagined there would be so many different responses.
Senpai...what drink do you recommend? I would like to know, for reference.

Have you had your first dream of the new year, Senpai?
I have yet to have my own, so I'm going to try my best tonight!
How about you exchange Pure Prisms for materials you're running low on? Da Vinci was saying that she could process them into various materials...just in limited quantities.

Have you had your first dream of the new year, Senpai?
I have yet to have my own, so I'm going to try my best tonight!

Butterbur plants are starting to sprout from the ground. Apparently they make delicious tempura.
Huh? They're bitter? I...see... So it's an acquired taste.

I just ran into Chiyome in the cafeteria, but she seemed a little sluggish. It's strange, since the air conditioning should be on...
Based on her legend as a Heroic Spirit, do you think she's more affected by the seasons than the actual temperature?
The pancake party Martha hosted was quite the sight! Not only were there pancakes from one end of the table to the other, but when the pancake race started, Xiang Yu's perfect dash stole the show!

The White Day event...is generally a day meant for giving return gifts for Valentine's Day gifts... Apparently it's unique, not seen in other countries. Even though there are similar events, it's interesting to learn that there are different variations of it depending on the region, culture, and age.

There are many types of Mystic Codes available for you to wear. There are various skills installed in each, so you may find one that fits your style after trying several on. Of course, it is also a great idea to dress for the season, too!

Have you ever seen a field of canola flowers before, Senpai? I hear the entire field looks like it was painted yellow, and is quite the sight to see. I do hope to see them with my own eyes one day. When that time comes, I would love to go see them with you.

I just saw Nero jogging through the halls in her gym uniform. Let's just put aside the fact that she's not using the simulator; I think it's a wonderful idea to start exercising as the weather grows warmer. Would you care to join her, Senpai?

If you starting to run low on Holy Grails, I suggest you try the "Holy Grail Casting" function in the Shop. It does use a massive amount of resources, but there's no doubt it will be a great help in enhancing your battle strength!

Oh, here's another painted Easter egg! Based on the magnificent artistry, there's no doubt this is Hokusai's work!
...Now that I think about it, this egg is probably worth a lot...

Flower viewing dumplings are typically colored pink, white, and green. There are theories about why they're colored that way, and one of them is that pink represents the spring flowers, white represents the winter snow, and green the summer leaves. The reason autumn is not included is to stop the dumplings from "falling" out of favor. Hehe, how amusing.

One of the theories as to why the Japanese calendar's term for April is "Uzuki" states the "u" carries the meaning of "new" or "birth," and symbolizes the start of the planting season.
The cycle of the year begins in April...why not try something new yourself, Senpai?

Are you aware of the superstition about April Fools, which says any lies you tell on that day will never happen? So if you claimed you ate the most delicious food in your life... Ah! Um, that was not a lie! That was just a way of explaining!

I hear there is a ceremony called "Tango no Sekku." There's a tradition of eating bamboo shoots on this day with wishes for boys to grow tall and strong like bamboo.
It's a wonderful custom. Let's ask Cat to make us some bamboo dishes!

The second Sunday of May is Mother's Day. May I suggest you give a carnation to those who always watch over you so warmly?
For instance...I'm sure Raikou would be thrilled to receive one!

Have you ever gone clam digging before, Senpai? 
You typically dig up short-neck clams or Poker Chip Venus clams, but there are also Gould's razor shells, surf clams, and mactra chinensis...
Hehe, there are so many different clams, it's like digging up treasure.

Master, have you ever checked the Materials from My Room? You can revisit memories you made with your Servants or the journeys you've taken in the past. 
Maybe it's a good idea to look back on precious memories now and then.
June is when lavender flowers are in full bloom. Would you care for one in your room, Senpai? Its scent is very relaxing and may help you get a good night's sleep.

In Japan, you can hear frogs in the rice paddies at this time of year. It's their way of finding a partner to court.
What? It's like a deafening chorus and you can hardly sleep because of the noise!? What astonishing power, considering their small size...

It's that time of year again! Melons are in season! We can make them into ice cream, juice, jelly, and cakes! 
What is your favorite, Senpai!?

Append Skills can make or break a battle. 
Servant Coins and materials will be needed to unlock and strengthen these skills, but they can grant effects such as Special Attack against certain classes. If you have materials to spare, I recommend it.

In Japan, the rainy season is said to end when the rain front moves northward and forms a high pressure zone in the Pacific Ocean. Before our laundry backlog reaches critical mass since we can't dry it outside, let's cheer for the Pacific Ocean high pressure zone to come!
"Marine Day" seems to be considered a holiday in Japan but it's often treated as just a festival overseas. Some countries offer fishing tournaments and aquarium tours!

Some of the Servants have been talking about other cultures in the world holding obstacle course races where competitors run carrying their partners.
 Orion has been spotted asking multiple women to volunteer... I've just received a report that he's been turned into stardust.

Buster, Quick, Arts...choosing each of these Cards during a turn will trigger a Mighty Chain that grants you three types of bonuses. 
 As you keep an eye on how the battle plays out, try to get these bonuses when the opportunity presents itself!

Ack! 
Oh, it's you, Senpai. You gave me a scare. Murasaki Shikibu was just telling me a Japanese ghost story... It was a spine-chilling story fit for telling on a summer night!

I hear many people in Japan float lanterns down rivers in memory of the deceased at this time of year. It is said that the sight of so many lights floating down tranquil water is truly majestic.
 I would like to participate one day.

August is the month when the Bayreuth Music Festival is held in Germany. It's said to be the most prestigious music concert in the world and the tickets are said to be very difficult to obtain. 
Do you think we can try asking a Servant with EX-ranked Luck to get tickets?

Quests will have enemies with various classes. Check out the Class Affinity to set Servants in your party who will have the advantage to help you get through the tough battles. 
And of course, don't forget your Shielder when in need! I know I can help!
Did you know that the Respect for the Aged Day is not unique to Japan? I hear the United States and other nations have Grandparents' Day. Every country values respect for the aged, don't they?

Early sunrises, late sunsets...
When the days get long, it's nice to feel how long the days are, Senpai.

Okay, provisions should be stored in multiple different places...

People in Japan think the surface of the moon looks like a rabbit, while people in other countries see something else. Some see a dog, some a crocodile, while some see an old woman reading a book. There really are so many different perspectives. What do you see, Senpai? Do you see a rabbit?

Senpai, do you have any Command Codes? 
 When you select "Command Code" from the Enhancement screen and engrave one on a Command Card, it can apply a number of effects. They can be replaced, so you should try engraving different ones on the cards.

First, soak in water forty degrees Celsius for twenty minutes and then... 
Huh? You thought I was preparing a bath? No, that's not it. This is prep for chestnut rice! Nothing beats the sweet, alluring aroma of steaming hot chestnuts and rice... 
I will let you know once it's ready, Senpai!

The seven herbs that represent autumn are known for how people enjoy viewing their flowers, rather than the seven herbs that represent spring, which are famously enjoyed as food. The idea is to take in their lovely appearances and find joy in the arrival of the coming season. 
Bush clover, bellflower, arrowroot, thoroughwort, golden lace, pampas grass, dianthus. The string of names has a nice rhythm!

Autumn is the season of art, food, sports...it's the season where people feel like trying new things! Autumn is when the weather is pleasant and there are no busy events, so people can concentrate and devote themselves to something they choose. All that is why we typically say "autumn of something-something." It makes sense!

Servants have Class Skills. These are triggered automatically during battle. Some strengthen the Servants themselves, while some may create disadvantages to the party. Check out the Servants' status screen to see what skills they have.

Numerous Servants, including Shuten and Anastasia, have requested more kotatsu tables...or personal ones. Because we have been unable to keep up with the demand, I hear a mysterious organization has even emerged to distribute kotatsu illegally... We may need to deal with this as soon as possible.

According to the calendar, the first day of winter has arrived and so has winter itself. 
Have you prepared your winter wardrobe yet, Senpai?  Please do so if you haven't already.  Once the biting winter wind picks up, the temperature will drop drastically.

In America, Thanksgiving is around when all the major sales kick off for the holiday season. They say it's one of the biggest sales of the year and the biggest day for profit. There may be big deals in store!

Surprisingly, this year is more than half over. 
Let's make a plan in advance and calmly carry it out, Master!

Senpai, are you thirsty? If you're tired, let me give you a massage!
 It's the season to give thanks for all your hard work, so you should sit back and relax!

It's that time of year when the city is filled with dazzling lights. There are famous places for that, like the Rockefeller Center in New York or the Christmas Market in Germany...
 I would very much like to go see them myself one day. With you, of course, Senpai!
Senpai, let's hurry to the cafeteria! Martha, Bhīma, and Goredolf each prepared an original turkey dish for everyone! We can't miss this opportunity! I'm ready for this!

There are only a few more days left in the year. Have you had an opportunity to organize your Spirit Origin storage? It may house precious memories, resources, and even things we aren't sure why are there. It might be best to check it out at least once.
Happy New Year, Senpai. I look forward to spending this year with you. I wish you a fulfilling year, both physically and mentally!

Have you visited the shrine for the new year, Senpai? Praying at the shrine may seem a bit stuffy but it is a great opportunity for you to give thanks for the past year and wish for good health in the new year.

Happy New Year, Senpai. I look forward to spending this year with you.
Hehe...I feel so fortunate to be able to greet you in the new year like this.

Senpai, do you have a favorite mochi dish? Grilled mochi, zouni soup, zenzai... I see, you like them all, hm? Hehe, you may not be able to eat them all at once, but let's tackle them one by one!

It's almost the first full moon festival, so I'm going to try to learn how to make red bean porridge from Beni-Enma. The red of the azuki beans is said to ward off evil spirits and it's also associated with good health.
The New Year celebrations in Japan sure do overflow with delicious food.
I heard people go to the beach in the summer. A bathing suit... I don't think I'm ready for that, but I'd like to ray shift at the beach and go swimming.

I hear snow festivals are held around this time of year in Japan. Galatea mentioned that she saw some reference materials to them and was inspired creatively. Then, with help from Sitonai, she is planning to create an ice sculpture of Da Vinci. Perhaps we should join her.

Senpai, do you know that there's a festival called the Holi? It's a celebration of the arrival of spring where people throw colored powder and water at each other. But then the colored powder stays on you for a few days... Hehe, it must be funny seeing everyone the next day.

It may be sakura mochi confectionery season, but it is kusa mochi—mochi mixed with herbs—season as well. So, Senpai, I asked the cafeteria to prepare kusa mochi. 
 Let's get into the spring spirit by having some as we sip on tea Rikyu made for us.

The word "Yayoi", which is another name for March in Japanese, originates from a phrase that describes spring: "the moon that peeks through the lush trees and grass." However, it's still not uncommon to have cold nights, so be careful not to get sick.

Professor Moriarty's lecture the other day was so interesting. We had Ruler Professor Moriarty and Archer Professor Moriarty both take two completely different approaches and still both arrived at the same answer.
Did you have unique lectures like that when you went to school too, Senpai?
I hear cherry blossom festivals are held at this time of year even in the United States! I'm so glad to hear cherry blossoms are loved even in countries across the sea!

Miss Crane mentioned the other day that pastel colors are most appropriate for spring. After hearing that, I saw Medb carrying a set of pastel pink armor and looking for somebody... I wonder if she managed to get them to wear it...

...So this is Earth's summer...
Do your best, Senpai. Don't let the heat get you down.

It's spring, which means new beginnings! All right, let's go!
Oh, um...I wasn't psyching myself up, but rather the people who are beginning the next stage in their lives! I hope they get off to a good start and have a great Golden Week in May.

Oh, um...I wasn't psyching myself up, but rather the people who are beginning the next stage in their lives! I hope they get off to a good start and have a great Golden Week in May.

That would be hachijuuhachi-ya in the traditional Japanese calendar, yes?
Apparently, the kanji for the number 88 can be rearranged to form the character for "rice," and it's considered very auspicious for agriculture.
Combining kanji and making lucky charms...
Japan has such unique customs.

Senpai, would you care to join me for a workout?
The month of May tends to have good weather, so it's the perfect time to get some exercise.
Let's work up a light sweat and stay healthy!

Potatoes are finally in season...
Their skins are thin, they have high water content, and they're terrifyingly addictive when steamed and topped with butter... Yes, that's how fearsome the new potato crop is!
There's no stopping them, so we'd better burn some calories!

Have you ever gone on a café crawl, Senpai?
I've read about how wonderful it is to try out the service and menus at each place and find your favorites.
Apparently, some cafés are themed around conversation with the staff or listening to music...
That's the essence that gives color to a peaceful life...

Pearl is June's birthstone. I've heard pearls are produced in many countries.
But most of the biggest pearls, many over eight millimeters in size, come from Japan.
Wait, are the gold and silver pearls I occasionally see in books...
(No, that is unrelated.)

Master, they're serving boiled edamame in the cafeteria. Would you like to try some with me?
Everyone who wants a snack is gathering there. Uesugi's out in front.

Edamame has a magical quality of charming you into always reaching for more!

The rainy season has a gloomy reputation but on the bright side, the sound of rain has a number of benefits.
It can improve concentration, reduce stress, and help with rest and recovery.
Instead of seeing a rainy day as a bad thing, why don't you try taking the time to focus on reading or studying?
Well done, Master. You should go ask the doctor for some shaved ice when you get a chance.

Some Craft Essences can increase the likelihood of obtaining specific materials.
If you're running short on materials, check if you have the corresponding Craft Essence.
Every little bit helps!

Senpai, this might sound sudden, but do you put salt on your watermelon or not?
The Servants are all divided on the issue.
Some argue they want to taste the sweetness, while others say salt brings out the freshness...
As for me... I'd focus on properly enjoying the watermelon first.

There's no beating unagi on the day of the ox in midsummer!
...Pardon me, I got a little too excited.
Apparently, the old custom was to eat foods that start with "u," such as umeboshi or uri...
And in the Edo period, they settled on unagi.
Clearly, the Edo period must be protected at all costs!

I've heard that the Festival of San Fermín is held in Spain around this time of year.
It involves all sorts of festivities, from bullfighting to parades...
But the most famous of them has to be the running of the bulls.
Apparently, every morning, people run ahead of six bulls.
Oh, um, I'm not talking about you, Red Hare.
Wait, hold on! Red Hare! Red Haaaare!

Average summer temperatures have been gradually rising lately.
Make sure you're ready for the heat, Master.
Why? Well...
The greatest and hottest summer festival is about to begin!

Senpai, here's a late summer greeting card.
The calendar says it's autumn but the heat is still lingering.
Make sure you take precautions when you go out, like wearing a hat and staying hydrated.

Summer and windchimes go hand in hand, don't you agree?
Apparently their original purpose was fortune telling, but once they came to Japan, they spread far and wide as talismans.
Over the years they became associated with the feeling of a cool breeze, giving us the modern windchime. 
Right then, I wanted to ask you something!
I got this windchime from Erice, but since Chaldea is fully air-conditioned...where should I hang it?

Senpai, I made an incredible discovery!
It seems like even the goldfish you win in a carnival game can grow to be huge in the proper environment.
The world record of 47.4 cm is probably out of reach...but with enough love, it could get close!

Senpai, is the most recent investigation report going well?
Just like with homework over summer break, it's best to get a little done every day.

Here you are, have some nice, cool barley tea. 
Stay hydrated so the heat doesn't wear you out, Senpai.
This heat isn't going to let up any time soon, but I hear the dog days of summer are the best. Keep fighting, Master!

It's easy to get sick when the seasons change. 
Take care of yourself, Senpai.
By the way... Do you think Fou has a fur shedding season?
Now that it's gotten cooler, it's much easier to be active. Would you like to come train with me, Senpai?
Autumn food is delicious. I love freshly baked bread!
Fall foliage... I hear that in Japan, the mountains become completely covered in red leaves, like they're on fire... I'd love to go and see the leaves with you, Senpai.

Do you have your coat ready? 
It's finally getting cold out, Master.

Please inform me if you catch a cold. 
I'll do my best to nurse you back to health!

Next month is packed with events. 
Are you ready, Senpai?

This year is nearly over. 
Keep working hard until the end, Master!
The decisive battle is near, but please try to relax here. Let's do this the way we always do.
It's cold outside, but I feel warm when you're near, Senpai. Is this also an example of the heat island effect?

It seems there are many benefits of eating rice cakes, such as longevity. 
Master, what do you think about having rice cakes at every meal?

So this is Ozoni soup... 
It's very tasty. It feels like it's warming me up from inside.
It's been very cold... I'm just a little jealous of Fou.

There's a warm spring waiting for us if we can just get through this cold. 
Let's be sure to keep warm until then, Master!

There's a sweet smell coming from somewhere...
Senpai, do you like sweets?

If we added wheels to a kotatsu, that would be an amazing machine...
I'm sure it'd be more useful than Da Vinci's gauntlets...

It's eased up a bit, but it's still chilly. 
Make sure to wrap up warmly when you sleep, Senpai.

I hear that in Japan, spring is known as the season of meeting and parting. 
Both of them are important.

I heard that everything is dyed pink when the cherry blossoms are in full bloom... 
If such a dreamy landscape exists I'd like to go see it with you, Senpai.

It's a lot warmer now, but spring is also cold season. 
Senpai, please take care of yourself even more than usual, okay?

Hay fever... yes, I hear that the symptoms are terrible. 
Are you all right Senpai?

I get sleepy when it gets warmer. Shall we rest a bit?
Leave the schedule to me. If you let me know when you want to be woken up, I'll wake you up on the dot!

It's much easier to carry out daily activities now that it's warmer.
But I kind of miss the cool of winter a little.

Here, have a warm cup of tea.
It's not the best grade of tea... but I hope you like it.

When I'm with you my heart rate changes.
...Is this a symptom of the so-called "Senioritis," Senpai?

It's a very rainy season, isn't it?
Let's check the weather for our destination so we don't get wet, or just carry an umbrella everywhere!

It's time for short sleeves, but do you have UV protection, Master?
Careful attention is effective in the long run.

S-so this is a teruteru bozu, the Japanese talisman said to bring good weather!
I see...
It does look like it's smiling at me.
How cute!

It feels like it really is summer, especially during the day.
But then again, it can get surprisingly chilly at night.
Let's make sure we regulate our body temperatures.

Um, Senpai, have you seen Fou around?
I haven't seen him anywhere...

A festival?
I hear that in Japan one wears a summer kimono to enjoy watching fireworks while eating things called "cotton candy" and "chocolate-covered bananas."
If I have the chance, I would like to watch fireworks with Senpai.

Leave it to Mash Kyrielight, Master.
I shall obtain two servings of frozen treats, right away!

Let's be mindful of our health if we want to enjoy our summer.
Don't forget to stay hydrated, Senpai.

It may be hard to sleep when it's so hot, but make sure you don't overuse the AC.
I hear that getting too cold is bad for even the sturdiest of psyches!

It's still very hot, but summer will be over soon.
I suggest we prepare for fall!

There's only a little over three months left in the year.
If there's anything you haven't finished yet, you should get to work soon!

I hear that in Japan there is a time of the year where the deceased are remembered.
To know that such a thing has taken root warms my heart.

Senpai, I have freshly-baked bread, so I would like to share―
Calories...?
...No, I've never heard that word before.
...This is the first I've ever heard of it.

The temperature difference between night and day is getting more extreme.
Do not forget to bring a jacket when you go out.

I hear that sunsets during this season are particularly beautiful. A heartwarming, nostalgic kind of thing...
Chaldea is my home, so it's disappointing that I do not get to see many sunsets.

There are still warm days, but the nights are truly chilly...
Shall I prepare something warm to drink, Senpai?

How are you keeping yourself from getting sick, Senpai?
Don't forget to always wash your hands and stay warm! You should be diligent!

I hear that when it gets cold, people yearn for the touch of another.
Senpai... Is...is that true?

The battle for the warmth of the kotatsu―The First Kotatsu War―has broken out, and casualties are mounting...
Master, let's go.
We need to put an end to this.

...The investigators from the Mage's Association are coming soon...
I'm sure big changes are coming, but I hope that my memories of these past two years will remain the same...and Doctor's room, too.

Herring roe, rolled kelp, kurikinton...
What is your favorite osechi dish, Senpai?

Da Vinci has prepared a game of hanetsuki and bamboo stilts in the Recreation Room, for a limited time.
Would you like to go, Senpai?
A new year may have come, but it's still the dead of winter. Please take good care of yourself, Senpai.

February...
It's the season of sweet smells floating through the air. We need to be careful about eating too many sweets, Master.

It's so cold, I won't be surprised if it starts snowing.
If it does snow, I would like to make an igloo.

Tangerines, tea, and a dotera robe...
Tee hee, what do you think, Senpai? I am a proper kotatsu Master now, right?

Winter or spring... I'm not sure which seasonal equipment to chose right now.
I suppose it's a nice problem to have, though.
It seems the men are working hard on something...

Grass and trees waiting to sprout through a covering of snow...
With that image in mind, let's store up our power, too!

Oh, Senpai...I'm sorry, I didn't notice you.
It's so warm, and holding onto Fou...so fluffy... It's so nice... Just sitting here...
Zzzzz... Zzzz...

...Wow, that thunder was loud.
So this is the iconic spring thunder...
Though it's hard not to wonder if someone just fired off their Noble Phantasm, too.

A new battlefield... New equipment...
Our situation seems dire, but let's take a deep breath and move forward!

The days are no longer just nice and warm, but truly hot.
Summer is getting close, Senpai.

...?

I see, sweet flag water...

Have you gotten used to riding the Shadow Border?
I hope we have some medicine for car sickness...

Let's keep up this pace, Senpai!

Reward acquired. 
Use it wisely, Senpai.

Clink, clink... Huh!?

Let's move forward, one step at a time!

I want to keep saying this so that we never lose our sense of accomplishment:
Good work, Senpai!

Idle time can make a person negligent.

I'm a little curious...
Just how many Fragments have you collected so far?

Hmmm, hm, hmmm, hmmm, hmmm, hmmm♪
Hm, hm...gyah!?

This is where I get to show off my dryer and brush technique!

I've only seen it in the videos in the library, but I would love to see real fireflies glow.
And hopefully...um...with Senpai...

Lostbelts...
The possibilities that were deemed unnecessary and placed on dead-end tracks...
So those are what our next enemies are going to be...
